test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which two steel plants were set up in collaboration with Russia (former USSR)?

options.text: Rourkela Steel Plant and Bokaro Steel Plant
Bokaro Steel Plant and Bhilai Steel Plant
Rourkela Steel Plant and Bhilai Steel Plant
Durgapur Steel Plant and Bokaro Steel Plant

solution:
Correct answer is __Bokaro Steel Plant and Bhilai Steel Plant.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• Steel plants that were set up with Russian collaboration are Bokaro Steel Plant in Jharkhand and Bhilai Steel Plant in Chhattisgarh.
 
• Bokaro Steel Plant is situated in the Bokaro district of Jharkhand. 
 
• It is the fourth integrated public sector steel plant in India built with Soviet help.
 
• Bhilai Steel Plant, be one of the largest in India, this industrial city is situated about 25 km far from Raipur.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Rourkela Steel Plant is located on the northwestern tip of Odisha.
 
• Durgapur steel plant (DSP) is situated in the Durgapur district of West Bengal.​ 
 
• Bhilai Steel Plant has been the head integrated steel plant unit of the Public Sector steel company, the Steel Authority of India Limited, and is its largest and most profitable production facility.
